name: Scrim
purpose: Full-window layer behind a modal, a menu or the lightbox. Dims the window, and a press on it outside the panel dismisses. Also the invisible click-catcher under a context menu.
base: Radix Dialog Overlay (soft and strong-blur); a plain layer for none

values.when: bg-black/30 (oklab 0 0 0 / 0.3), no blur. Sheets and the command palette.
Strong dim plus backdrop blur, flex column, full window. Attachment lightbox. B's separate blur axis is folded here.
Invisible full-window hit area under a menu; catches clicks and right-clicks outside the menu.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Mousedown outside the panel dismisses the owning layer (B's onPress).

keyboard: None; Escape belongs to the owning modal or menu.
platform: Web: under Dialog overlay, CommandPalette overlay and Lightbox overlay. Desktop: no scrim for dialogs or sheets (decision). The invisible click-catcher for menus is still needed on desktop unless native menus are used (undecided).
open: Lightbox: whether a bare click on the scrim closes it is not confirmed (Overlay source not read). The scrim colour is a literal (bg-black/30), not a token. Palette and lightbox presentation on desktop open.
